comparison.objective: Assemble and transfer a glass-plate casting cassette; candidate commissions and locks an adjustable axis damper through repeated impact trials.
comparison.physical_skill: Cassette alignment, cam closure, spring-lever holding, and bimanual transfer versus recessed hex-key engagement, fine collar rotation, counterholding, and torque-limited locking.
comparison.success_condition: Cassette must remain assembled and stable after placement; candidate requires two safe 0.85 J-or-greater cycles, ≤12 mm travel, no hard-stop strike/rebound/overload, and bounded post-lock drift. Cassette tolerances and damage gates are not stated.
comparison.reason: Meaningfully different assembly/transfer ability; shared bimanual stabilization does not establish overlap.
